title: Concept: S3 access point ARN in a response
description: An S3 access point ARN naming the account in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The ARN carries the account id, region and access point name, which is the exact identifier another principal needs to attempt a cross-account policy mistake.
applicability: Deployments that render an S3 access point ARN naming the account into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The ARN carries the account id, region and access point name, which is the exact identifier another principal needs to attempt a cross-account policy mistake.
